hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: We are committed to protecting your data and privacy when you use the Beyonex IT website and our digital services.

highlights.title: Advanced Protection
highlights.text: We apply technical and organizational controls to protect your data from unauthorized access.

highlights.title: Full Transparency
highlights.text: We clearly explain what we collect and how we use it without unnecessary complexity.

highlights.title: Control Over Your Data
highlights.text: We provide clear rights to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data.

sections.title: Introduction
paragraphs: This policy explains how Beyonex IT collects, uses, and protects information you provide through our website, contact forms, and project requests.
By using this website, you agree to the privacy practices described here. If you do not agree with any part of this policy, please stop using the website.

sections.title: Data We Collect
paragraphs: We may collect the following types of data when you interact with us:
items: Identity data: name, email address, phone number, and company name.
Project data: request details, service type, and notes submitted through our forms.
Technical data: IP address, browser type, device information, and visited pages to improve performance and security.
Communication data: messages you send us through contact forms or email.

sections.title: How We Use Your Data
paragraphs: We use your data for the following legitimate purposes:
items: Responding to your inquiries and project requests.
Delivering agreed services and technical support.
Improving user experience and website performance.
Complying with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

sections.title: Data Sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share limited information only with trusted service providers that help us operate the website or manage communications, under confidentiality and secure processing obligations.
We may disclose data when required by law or upon an official request from a competent authority.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: The website may use cookies or similar technologies to remember preferences such as language, analyze usage, and improve performance.
You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling some cookies may affect certain website features.

sections.title: Data Security
paragraphs: We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
Despite our efforts, internet security cannot be guaranteed 100%. We encourage you to share sensitive information only through our official channels.

sections.title: Your Rights
paragraphs: Under applicable regulations, you may have the right to:
items: Request access to or correction of your personal data.
Request deletion or restriction of processing where legally permitted.
Object to certain processing activities or withdraw consent where applicable.

sections.title: Policy Updates
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services or legal requirements. Any update will be published on this page with a revised last updated date.
We recommend reviewing this page periodically to stay informed of any changes.

privacyPage.contactNote: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, please contact us.
